name: Auto-fixes help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) of the Auto-fixes plugin.
author: Brett

entries.title: Auto-fixes
entries.text: Every call that failed and is being fixed automatically, the fix it is trying now, and the ones that gave up with what is missing. Tap a row for its full Automatic fixes log.

entries.title: Auto-fixes banner
entries.text: Shows while a failed call is being fixed or has given up. Tap a row to open its log; tap the count for the full list.

entries.title: A failing call
entries.text: What failed, which fix it is trying now (step n of m) and how many attempts so far. Tap to open its Automatic fixes log.

entries.title: Auto-fixes settings
entries.text: Show it as its own banner across the top, as a widget on the banner bar, or only on its page. Switches live in every open console.

entries.title: Show it as
entries.text: Where Auto-fixes shows: its own strip across the top (only while something is failing), a badge on the banner bar, or only on its page. Switches live in every open console.

entries.title: Auto-fixes banner
entries.text: Calls that failed and are being fixed on their own: what failed, the fix it is trying now and attempts so far. Tap a row to open its Automatic fixes log.

steps.say: Calls that failed are fixed here on their own: each failure kind has a ladder of fixes, tried once each.
Tap a row to see every attempt; dismiss one that gave up once you've dealt with it.
